podcast.title: Andy Bell's Solo Work
podcast.body: Andy Bell pursued solo projects independently of E-Racer, without leaving the band. This demonstrates that a band member can have an independent career without causing the dissolution of their main group. "Andy Bell ha tenido trabajos en solitario al margen de E-Racer sin dejar a E-Racer."
